name: GenerateMsgDraft
pure_preflight: recipient/template/content bounds and destination safety check
transaction_boundary: build and structurally verify deterministic temp MSG outside DB transaction; atomically publish operator file; then one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork records/reuses draft + recipients + export metadata, command receipt and audit; DB failure does not mutate source mail and retry with same semantic input can reconcile the already-published matching artifact hash
authoritative_reads: origin context validity supplied by originating domain command contract
guards: destination is local operator-selected file path and not within protected source PST/OST path
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 plus origin_command_id/content_fingerprint unique semantic draft key
receipt_order: replay -> validate/reconcile published artifact hash -> insert command_receipt -> draft/recipient/export rows -> audit/results -> commit
revision_effects: new draft revision=1; repeated same origin/content reuses identity/export evidence without creating sent Communication
post_commit_work: none; later PST/OST discovery is independent processing
